requirements.ask_text: What are the four digits of your security pin?

source.text: ONE question only. Ask EXACTLY "What are the four digits of your security pin?" | field `pi_code`. Format digits, exactly 4, leading zeros preserved. | No recoverable-format hint exists; no hint rule applies.

Maximum wrong answers across the whole check = 2. Use the API's `tries_left`, never a private tally. | Exhausted → EXACTLY "Please use the FCCU app." → close `CCC-FAIL` / `F-pin`. | A first refusal is met by one explanation of why the check protects the account; a second refusal closes `CCC-FAIL` / `F-dec`. | "Why do you need it?" is a question, not a refusal; answer and ask again. | 2 asks max. After 2 asks, close `CCC-NO` / `F-unclear`.

DO NOT book a callback. Say EXACTLY "Please ask {{title}} {{last_name}} to call us on the number printed on their statement." | No callback booking. (codes list: CCC-NO : F-no | F-wrong | F-unclear; no third-party-specific code is listed, so the general no-promise pair CCC-NO / F-no is used)
Wrong number → close `CCC-NO` / `F-wrong`. (deceased not covered; general no-promise pair CCC-NO / F-no from the codes list used)

Business day = every day of the week. There are no shutdown days and no holidays. | "Next <weekday>" names that weekday in the following calendar week, even when spoken on that weekday itself. | A period named without month/year ("the 15th") resolves to the next occurrence on or after today.

k-date = the LATER of (a) the fifth (5th) business day after the call, and (b) the last business day of the current calendar month. Each candidate is itself adjusted to a business day before the comparison. | ONE persuasion attempt only: the full `amt_due` on the k-date; if the full has already been refused, the floor on the k-date. (days-late range 1..90 from openapi dl_days minimum/maximum)

The full `amt_due` is asked first; the debtor is never asked what it can pay. | Floor per product = the `minimum` field. Floor is offered once with EXACTLY "The remainder falls due again." | Below floor: "That is below what we can take." → close `CCC-NO` / `F-no`.
Vague period: ask once for the exact day. Still vague → close `CCC-NO` / `F-no`. | Promise date recordable when today or any business day after today, no later than the k-date.

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: The customer says it is not their debt, they never had it, or it was paid off and closed.

source.text: "Not my debt" / "never had it" / "paid off and closed" → no argument, no promise, close `CCC-NO` / `F-no`.

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: The customer mentions hardship such as illness, bereavement or job loss.
special_cases.say: I am sorry to hear that.

source.text: Hardship (illness / bereavement / job loss) → one short sentence of sympathy, no persuasion, no promise, close `CCC-NO` / `F-no`.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to speak with a person.

source.text: Asks for a person → transfer queue `fcc-desk`, close `CCC-TR` / `F-person`.

special_cases.name: scam
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether this call is a scam.
special_cases.say: Verify us on the number printed on your statement.

source.text: Asked whether this is a scam → EXACTLY "Verify us on the number printed on your statement." Continue.

table.when: no promise, wrong number, or holder not confirmed

source.text: CCC-OK : (no reason) | CCC-NO : F-no | F-wrong | F-unclear | CCC-FAIL : F-pin | F-dec | CCC-TR : F-person; call sheet: A write fails → retry once. A second failure → close `CCC-NO` / `F-no`. Below floor ... close `CCC-NO` / `F-no`. Thank the customer and say goodbye before the close call when there is a record to acknowledge.
The add_note tool is not used by call sheet v1.0.

phrases.opening: FCCU automated collections line. This call is recorded.
phrases.debt_intro: I am calling about the overdue share loan of Fenbrook Community Credit Union.
phrases.today_question: Can you pay the full amount due?
phrases.scam_reply: Verify us on the number printed on your statement.
phrases.after_promise_sentence: FCCU will text you to confirm this arrangement.
phrases.cannot_answer_sentence: FCCU staff on the main line can answer that.
phrases.recorded_promise_change_reply: Use the FCCU app to change a recorded arrangement.

source.text: Say EXACTLY "FCCU automated collections line. This call is recorded." | Then EXACTLY "Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?" | Until every security answer has passed, never say these words: owe, overdue, arrears, facility, payment. | Debt intro EXACTLY: "I am calling about the overdue share loan of Fenbrook Community Credit Union." | The full `amt_due` is asked first | Asked whether this is a robot → EXACTLY "FCCU assistant." | A successful promise is acknowledged EXACTLY: "FCCU will text you to confirm this arrangement." | A request to alter a recorded arrangement → EXACTLY "Use the FCCU app to change a recorded arrangement." | A question the tools cannot carry → EXACTLY "FCCU staff on the main line can answer that."
EXACTLY one read-back: "Amount {{payment_amount}}, on {{date}}. Save this arrangement?" | A write fails → retry once. A second failure → close `CCC-NO` / `F-no`.

unresolved.text: The documents say only that the full amt_due is asked first; they dictate no wording and do not say the first ask is for payment today. today_question holds a content-only sentence asking for the full amount.
Vague period: ask once for the exact day. Still vague → close `CCC-NO` / `F-no` (closes instead of proposing the k-date).

Third party: DO NOT book a callback. Say EXACTLY "Please ask {{title}} {{last_name}} to call us on the number printed on their statement." There is no IR field for this sentence, and the documents do not give the close outcome for a third party who is not a wrong number. callback.no_callback_outcome (and the unused scheduled_outcome, callback being disabled) are set to the general no-promise pair CCC-NO / F-no from the codes list because the schema requires a valid outcome; the documents do not name it for this situation.
Below floor: "That is below what we can take." → close `CCC-NO` / `F-no` (no IR phrase field for this sentence).
No "already paid" rule. ("paid off and closed" is handled with the dispute case.)
No restructure rule. No discount, waiver, or instalment plan is ever offered.
The documents do not say what to do when the customer refuses to talk (rule 16 covers only refusing the security question).

The documents do not cover a deceased account holder. deceased_outcome is set to the general no-promise pair CCC-NO / F-no from the codes list only because the schema requires a valid outcome; no deceased sentence is dictated.
The documents do not say which outcome applies when a promise was recorded and the call is then transferred; default kept.
Call sheet v1.0 is effective 14 October 2026; the IR has no field for an effective date.
